dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: I was just here for a quick meal — not to have a waiter look down his nose at me for picking the wrong wine to go with my food!

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: I mean, aren't both Chardon and Corte white wines? Why do people have to make such a hue and cry about something as simple as a meal?

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: The most infuriating thing is that when I tried to resolve the situation by following his recommendation, not only was the price cheaper, but the flavor really was better than the one I'd picked originally.

dialogues.speaker: Eloise
dialogues.text: I mean, I should've thanked him, but his attitude really was... Darn it.
